_description: Search and Rescue sidecar config for land-based wreck detection (aircraft crash sites in terrain). Loaded by wreck_ml_trainer.py and lake_michigan_scan.py when environment='land' entries are processed.
_complement: sensor_config.json covers underwater/water-surface detection. This file covers land/terrain metal detection only.

band_priority._note: Ranked by utility for metal-on-land detection. SWIR penetrates vegetation canopy; thermal picks up differential heating; NIR/NDVI reveals impact clearing.

primary.purpose: Primary metal detector — aluminum/steel strongly reflects SWIR. Partial canopy penetration. High z-score bright patch = exposed metal.
Secondary SWIR — oxidized/corroded steel corrosion signature. Complement to B11.

secondary.purpose: Diurnal thermal anomaly — hollow fuselages and bare metal heat/cool faster than surrounding soil and canopy. Use morning imagery for cold-metal signatures, midday for hot-metal.
Persistent impact clearing — crash sites create vegetation gaps that remain detectable for decades. NDVI depression (lower than surrounding pixels) marks clearing edge.

avoid.reason: Blue — water penetration band; irrelevant on land.
Green — minimal discrimination of metal on land.

terrain_modes._note: Select the appropriate mode based on crash site environment. Controls which band combination and thresholds are used.

alpine_above_treeline.description: High altitude, minimal or no vegetation. Examples: Humphreys Peak AZ.
alpine_above_treeline.best_time_of_day: midday (11:00-14:00 local) for maximum thermal contrast

forested_conifer.description: Dense conifer forest (spruce, fir, pine). Year-round canopy. Examples: Mt. Success NH, Allenspark CO.
forested_conifer.canopy_penetration_note: B11 SWIR penetrates ~30-50% of dense conifer canopy. Increase z-threshold to reduce false positives from sun-lit canopy gaps. Best results when target is partially exposed (clearing edge or ridge).

forested_deciduous.description: Deciduous hardwood (oak, maple, birch). Canopy present May-October. Examples: Kaaterskill NY, Waterrock Knob NC.

leaf_off_window.note: Leaf-off exposes metal directly. Lower threshold during leaf-off season.

leaf_on_window.note: Full canopy attenuates SWIR. Rely on NDVI clearing depression and thermal instead.

forested_deciduous.best_time_of_day: morning for thermal, midday for SWIR leaf-off

coastal_cliff.description: Exposed rock face, minimal vegetation, coastal environment. Examples: Cape Lookout OR.
coastal_cliff.salt_oxidation_note: Coastal wrecks show enhanced oxidation in B12 (rust) and slight red-band elevation from iron oxide. Check B12/B11 ratio for salt-corroded iron signature.
coastal_cliff.ocean_adjacency_note: Check adjacent ocean pixels for residual fuel/oil sheen using HC pass (B11 dark water anomaly).
coastal_cliff.best_time_of_day: midday for maximum thermal contrast on bare rock

training_patch._note: Overrides wreck_ml_trainer.py PATCH_HALF=8 (17x17) for land wrecks. Land debris fields are larger and more dispersed than underwater hull footprints.
training_patch.patch_size_note: T-33/Beechcraft 18 (intact): use 10 (21x21 = 630m @ 30m/px). Cessna 182 Humphreys (scattered): use 20 (41x41 = 1230m). Default 12 (25x25 = 750m).
training_patch.negative_sample_strategy: sample from same tile at >500m from any known wreck GPS, within same terrain type (avoid sampling open water or road pixels as negatives)

detection_radius_m._note: Override for _flag_known_wreck() radius. Land debris fields are larger than underwater hull footprints.

scoring_weights._note: Feature importance adjustments for land-mode wreck scoring. Applied on top of base LightGBM model.

seasonal_collection_windows._note: Preferred satellite collection months per terrain type for maximum detection probability.

forested_conifer.reason: Low sun angle creates oblique illumination that enhances linear features (fuselage)

forested_deciduous.reason: Leaf-off window; direct SWIR view of metal

cmr_download_bands._note: Which HLS bands to request from CMR for land-SAR tile downloads.

pipeline_notes.trainer: wreck_ml_trainer.py: filter known_wrecks where environment=='land', use terrain_mode to select patch_half and z_threshold overrides, skip stumpf_ratio feature (land), weight NDVI depression and SWIR features.
pipeline_notes.scanner: lake_michigan_scan.py: PASS 1 skip land wrecks (water scanner). Land wrecks feed a separate land_scan pass using B11/B12/thermal bands. scan_bbox for each land site = 0.05 deg buffer around lat/lon.
pipeline_notes.geometry_sidecar: tile_geometry.py .geometry.json sidecar is still used — solar zenith correction applies to SWIR imagery for slope-aspect correction on mountain terrain.
pipeline_notes.tpu: TFLite model exported with environment='land' flag in metadata — TPU server routes to land model when lat/lon is not over water.
